passRule: The exact normalized payload and unsigned DMG are independently audited; the payload installs at the absent per-user destination and uninstalls without changing installed official Blender; official configuration remains exact; all F0 paths remain independent; both frozen round-trip rows preserve exact core semantic bytes and explicitly report optional-metadata degradation.
failureRule: Any protocol stop-rule condition is FAIL with immutable evidence and no same-ID repair after the first package mutation.

newAttemptCorrection.change: Separate the one-time hdiutil compression limit (180 seconds) from the unchanged six Blender process limit (60 seconds each), and use a fresh package root.
